highlights: The Ugreen KU004 90875 is a wired universal keyboard that is compatible with both Windows and macOS systems.
With a 1.5-meter long USB-A cable, it provides a stable connection that ensures reliable use.
The keyboard is designed in full size and allows for easy control of media, including volume adjustment and song changes.
An ergonomically optimized tilt angle of 6 degrees ensures that the hands and wrists remain in a comfortable position while typing.
Driver installation is not required, so the keyboard is ready to use immediately upon connection.
The Ugreen KU004 90875 is not only functional but also built for durability, as the keys can withstand up to 10 million keystrokes.
